title: Analysis of users' engagement with Generative AI features within Search Engines
description:
This study aims to provide methodologically rigorous, empirical data on user
engagement with generative AI features integrated into online search engines. The
contractor will be expected to measure, through observational and experimental
methods, how these features affect user behaviour, query reformulation, session
duration, and time spent on AI-generated content relative to organic results. The study will further characterise users' visual attention and information intake using eye-tracking or equivalent attention-measurement techniques, covering AI-generated answers, their citations, and surrounding organic results, and evaluate users' trust in AI- generated content, their verification behaviour, and their ability to recognise such content. These effects will be examined across different Member States, languages and demographics - with particular attention to vulnerable groups - and across query categories of public interest. (Maximum value of the procurement : 139,999 EUR Contract duration 12 months)

title: Mustererkennung & -analyse Pattern recognition and analysis
description: Ziel der Beschaffung des ersten Teilprojektes der Ausschreibung zu zukünftiger Cyberkriminalität “Mustererkennung und –analyse" ist die Erkennung und -analyse von Mustern im Bereich der Cyberkriminalität, welche frühzeitig auf globale Entwicklungen hindeuten sowie darauf aufbauend die Entwicklung eines Demonstrators in Form eines Frühwarnradars, das eine frühzeitige Detektion national grenzüberschreitender Entwicklungen im Bereich der Cyberkriminalität ermöglicht. Das Frühwarnradar soll neben technischen Faktoren vor allem kulturelle und strukturelle Bedingungen im Ländervergleich berücksichtigen, um mögliche Einflussfaktoren zu identifizieren, die bislang keine oder kaum Beachtung gefunden haben. Somit sollen Vorhersagen getroffen werden, die das Rekonstruieren und Antizipieren unterstützen, wie bestimmte Formen von Cyberkriminalität, Angriffsvektoren oder Modi Operandi an Relevanz gewinnen und ggf. auf andere Länder transferiert werden. Die Leistungserbringung ist in drei Phasen aufgeteilt. Die besten und innovativsten der konkurrierenden Lösungen werden im Rahmen des Verfahrens anhand der in den Vergabeunterlagen festgelegten Kriterien schrittweise ermittelt und ausgewählt. / The aim of the procurement of the first subproject (SP1) "Pattern recognition and analysis" of the call for tenders "Research into future cybercrime" (zCK) is the recognition and analysis of patterns in the field of cybercrime that indicate global developments at an early stage and, based on this, the development of a demonstrator in the form of an early warning radar that enables early detection of national cross-border developments in the field of cybercrime. In addition to technical factors, first and foremost the early warning radar is intended to take into account cultural and structural conditions in a country comparison in order to identify possible influencing factors that have so far received little or no attention. The aim is to make predictions that support the reconstruction and anticipation of how certain forms of cybercrime, attack vectors or modi operandi will gain relevance and possibly be transferred to other countries. The service provision is divided into three phases. The best and most innovative of the competing solutions will be progressively identified and selected during the procedure on the basis of the criteria set out in the tender documents.

title: GROWTH DEMONSTRATION PROJECTS IN ACCESS BASS - STANDARD CALL FOR PROPOSALS
description: The ACCESS (Accelerating Commercialisation and Competitiveness of the European Space Sector) programme helps companies develop innovative commercial products and services that strengthen European competitiveness in both space and non-space markets. It fosters a diverse and dynamic space ecosystem, ensuring that the benefits of commercialisation reach all Participating States.Business Applications and Space Solutions (BASS) is the element of ACCESS programme specifically designed to accelerate the transformation of innovative ideas into market-ready space-based services and applications that deliver measurable socio-economic impact.BASS offers to companies and academia derisking tools to mitigate technical and commercial risks, shortening the path from concept to market. With a strong user-driven focus, BASS creates the conditions for commercial success and positions space as a driver of innovation, competitiveness, and lasting value for society.To deliver these outcomes, BASS offers a comprehensive support package which includes zero-equity funding, tailored business and technical expertise, project management guidance, ESA branding, and access to commercialisation networks. This ecosystem connects companies with customers, investors, and partners, enabling them to overcome market barriers whilesecuring sustainable growth through private investment and demand-driven adoption.BASS support is tailored to every stage of developmentfrom assessing the viability of new space-based applications, to designing, implementing, and piloting space-based solutions and supporting their expansion into new markets.

title: 23-054.6 Maso zmrazené - pořízení a ochraňování — 2. část VZ: Dodávka a ochraňování 250 tun vepřového masa
description: Dodávka a ochraňování 250 tun vepřového masa v druzích a množství: - kýta bez kosti 50 tun, - plec bez kosti 100 tun, - pečeně bez kosti 50 tun, - krkovice bez kosti 50 tun. Předmětem veřejné zakázky (dále jen "VZ") je pořízení a ochraňování 500 t masa zmrazeného (dále i „maso“). Maso bude jako součást státních hmotných rezerv majetkem ČR. Předmět VZ je rozdělen dle § 35 zákona na 2 (dvě) samostatné části, a sice: 1. část VZ: Dodávka a ochraňování 250 tun vepřového masa v druzích a množství: - kýta bez kosti 50 tun, - plec bez kosti 100 tun, - pečeně bez kosti 50 tun, - krkovice bez kosti 50 tun. 2.část VZ: Dodávka a ochraňování 250 tun vepřového masa v druzích a množství: - kýta bez kosti 50 tun, - plec bez kosti 100 tun, - pečeně bez kosti 50 tun, - krkovice bez kosti 50 tun.
